x1.description: First input array. The elements must have integer dtype.
constraints: x1 and x2 must have the same dtype with integer type.
x1, x2 and output must have broadcast-compatible shapes.

x2.description: Second input array. The elements must have integer dtype.
constraints: x1 and x2 must have the same dtype with integer type.
x1, x2 and output must have broadcast-compatible shapes.

output.description: An array containing the least common multiple of the corresponding elements from the absolute values of `x1` and `x2`.

constraints: x1 and x2 must have the same dtype with integer type.
x1, x2 and output must have broadcast-compatible shapes.
